title: Briefwisseling van Constantijn Huygens 1607-1687
author: Constantijn Huygens and his correspondents
notes: Database of 9,237 letters to and from Constantijn Huygens (1596-1687), each with metadata and a facsimile of the original, linked to the text of J.A. Worp's edition (6 volumes, 1911-1917) in the Huygens 'retroboeken' viewer, which serves the text of each page as searchable OCR; new letters unpublished by Worp, and transcriptions and translations of selected letters (musical letters, letters of Anna Maria van Schurman and Lucia van Aerssen-Walta) are added. A metadata export (brieven.xls) is offered. Status active: the project blog has posts up to September 2026. Its texts could not be counted: the site refuses automated requests, and the text is OCR of Worp's printed edition with his introductions, notes and indexes mixed in.
